en.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Officially Announced for Switch 2 Preorder
en.summary: The next installment in the blockbuster Call of Duty franchise is set to launch on Nintendo's upcoming hardware. Preorders are live now, offering a glimpse into what fans can expect.
en.body:
It's official: **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4** is coming to the **Nintendo Switch 2**, and preorders are already live. This marks a monumental moment for Nintendo and the Call of Duty franchise, as a mainline entry in the series will be available on a Nintendo console for the first time. While Microsoft had previously pledged to bring Call of Duty titles to Nintendo platforms, seeing it materialize with a major release like Modern Warfare 4 is still a striking development.

The game is slated for an October 23 release, with a price point of $69.99. Interested players can secure their copy through retailers like Best Buy and GameStop, or digitally via the Nintendo eShop. However, a crucial detail for physical media enthusiasts has emerged: the game will not come on a traditional game card. Instead, physical copies will contain a redemption code for the Nintendo eShop, meaning players will still need to download the full game. This approach is understandable given the gargantuan file sizes Call of Duty games are known for; they frequently exceed 100GB, far surpassing the current 64GB capacity of Switch game cards. A dedicated Call of Duty launcher app will likely be employed, allowing players to select and download only the components they wish to play, such as the campaign, multiplayer, or Warzone.

## Modern Warfare 4's Switch 2 Debut

The Switch 2 version of **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4** promises the complete experience found on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. This includes the full campaign, which reportedly features a narrative set in Korea, along with the robust multiplayer suite and any associated battle royale components. The technical feat of bringing such a graphically intensive and content-rich game to Nintendo's next-generation portable hardware is considerable. Given the franchise's history of pushing graphical boundaries, it will be fascinating to see how Infinity Ward and the other development studios involved optimize the experience for the Switch 2's architecture.

## Preorder Bonuses and Early Access

Fans who preorder **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4** will receive exclusive in-game bonuses. These include the Hunter Killer Operator Skin and the Gilded Pearl Camo Pack, which provides two weapon camos. For those opting for the digital edition, an additional perk awaits: early access to the game's campaign starting October 16, a full week before the official launch. This early campaign access is a common incentive for Call of Duty preorders and offers dedicated fans a chance to dive into the story ahead of the wider player base.

## What's Next

With preorders now open and a clear release date set for October 23, the focus shifts to the official marketing campaign for **Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4**. Players can anticipate further details regarding gameplay features, multiplayer modes, and potential beta testing phases in the coming weeks.

content_raw: Here’s something I never thought I’d say: the upcoming Call of Duty game is now available to preorder for a Nintendo console. Granted, Microsoft said it would do this, but hearing it and seeing it are two different things. The game in question is Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and the Nintendo platform is the Switch 2. You can preorder it now at Best Buy . It costs $69.99 and is out on October 23. Preorder Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (Switch 2) Physical Get it at Best Buy - $69.99 Get it at GameStop - $69.99 Digital Get it at Nintendo eShop - $69.99 However, it’s definitely worth noting that physical copies of the game do not come on a game card. It’s not even a Game-Key Card . This is just a code in a box . So you’ll have the box to put on your shelf, but you’ll still have to redeem the game code on the Nintendo eShop and download the game to your Switch 2. Before you grab your pitchfork and torching every building in your neighborhood, it should be noted that there’s no way Modern Warfare 4 would fit on a Switch 2 game card. Currently, these carts can hold up to 64GB of storage . Call of Duty games are notorious for taking up well over 100GB of storage, depending on what modes you have installed. There’s a whole Call of Duty game launcher app that lets you pick and choose what parts you want downloaded on your system. Preorder Bonuses Preorder the game, and you’ll receive the following in-game items: Hunter Killer Operator Skin Gilded Pearl Camo Pack (2 weapon camos) Preorder the digital edition, and you’ll get the items listed above, plus early access to the campaign, starting October 16. What Is Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4? The Switch 2 version of Modern Warfare 4 includes the full game that you’d get on PS5 or Xbox Series X. It has the Korea-based campaign and the multiplayer modes — including the extraction-focused DMZ mode — though it’s worth noting that you’ll need a Nintendo Online subscription to play online. Per Activision's official website, here's the description for the campaign: "War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world. A young squad of South Korean soldiers fight to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him." This is the first Call of Duty game to release on a Nintendo platform since Call of Duty: Ghosts landed on Wii U in 2013. In related news, the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta will be free on Switch 2 this weekend . Playing can earn you some Beta rewards , including things like emblems and skins.
